title: Blackstar Shadow
text: Your shadow is darker than the room and heavier than your feet.
flavor: It reaches the exit first and waits there, patient.
trigger: When an effect would suppress a Scar or lasting pressure.
penalty: The suppression is weaker, then gain a note that the shadow has been fed.

effect.text: Blackstar Shadow fed: reduce this relief by 1.

relief: Spend a blackstar or void-salt item to let the full relief resolve.
upside: The first time this scar blocks relief each session, add +1 to your next guile check.
